sources.title: UNC5537 Targets Snowflake Customer Instances for Data Theft and Extortion
sources.supported: Investigated compromises traced to stolen customer credentials; impacted accounts lacked MFA; approximately 165 potentially exposed organizations notified, not a claim that all were confirmed breached.

sources.title: Cyber-security Incident Update
sources.supported: Probable compromised AWS access key, potentially exposed in public JavaScript artifacts; assessed database and attachments copied; exact objects and definitive attribution unavailable from logs.

sources.title: Guidance for charities affected by the Beacon cyber security incident
sources.supported: Regulator acknowledges incident and affected-charity reports, but does not supply IAM topology or confirmed object-level access.

sources.title: CVE-2026-64849
sources.supported: Unauthenticated webhook full-read SSRF can reach internal/cloud metadata; CVE describes a fix in 3.15.0; CISA enrichment records exploitation. Does not identify a victim role or demonstrate specific stolen cloud credentials.

sources.title: Unauthenticated full-read SSRF in MLflow webhook delivery
sources.supported: The original proof used a local simulated secret service because the reporter had no cloud deployment; capability evidence is not a named AWS compromise. Page version fields and later CVE/follow-up notes differ; this study does not issue patch guidance.

sources.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
sources.supported: July 10 publicly exposed write-capable Hugging Face credentials were recovered; later zero-days and worker compromise yielded additional credentials. Initial credential authority alone does not explain the exploit-enabled expansion.

sources.title: CircleCI Jan 4, 2023 security incident report
sources.supported: Malware stole a valid 2FA-backed SSO session; the employee's production-access privileges enabled access to a subset of stores including customer variables, tokens and keys; new production step-up controls were added.
